deferrals.reason: Repo targets Python 3.12/3.13 (requires-python >=3.12, CI matrix 3.12/3.13). 3.14 is pending upstream verification: openhands-sdk support for 3.14 is unconfirmed. Re-evaluate when the SDK's supported range covers 3.14.

deferrals.name: mcp
deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk->fastmcp-slim requires mcp>=1.24.0,<2.0, so mcp 2.x cannot be installed while the SDK pin stands. Re-check on the next openhands-sdk bump.
